title: Pais's career at Navy programs and Space Force

tellings.quote: fortunate to work for strategic systems programs at the Washington Navy Yard and then uh I went for the Space Force and

plain: Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist who holds patents for craft that sound like UFOs, says he worked for Strategic Systems Programs, the Navy office for submarine-launched nuclear missiles, at the Washington Navy Yard and then moved to the Space Force, the US military branch for space. He tells this about his own career, giving no dates. It matters because it places the man behind those patents inside serious defence work.
